purpose: Real-timeline 3D-to-2D camera feasibility; frozen GDI inference only if semantic input contract passes.
selection: selection.json; first dynamic trial of SUBJ01 SUBJ02 SUBJ03 TVC04 TVC08 TVC09, no replacement or concatenation
resampling: linear at exact t=k/30 within source endpoint; interpolation only between two valid adjacent samples; no time stretching, repeat, padding, or gap filling

camera.alignment: Z up; forward is endpoint displacement of midpoint of ASI markers; lateral=up cross forward; origin midpoint of first/last ASI XY, ground Z unchanged

conditions.side_pan: same fixed camera position, yaw follows ASI midpoint XY at constant camera height; no camera translation, pitch or zoom
conditions.oblique_fixed: position [-3.5*tan(15deg),-3.5,1], fixed horizontal optical axis aimed at origin XY

camera.assumption: Scenario parameters, not recovered calibration of either source study. Right-side interpretation checked against ASI anatomy.

projection_output: Original named surface markers plus named virtual segment axes; no claim of BODY25 joint equivalence; preserve NaN and out-of-frame coordinates and flag them

gdi_gate.required_landmarks: BODY25 hips knees ankles big toes with established anatomical mapping
gdi_gate.known_toe_mismatch: LTOE/RTOE are second metatarsal-head markers, not BODY25 big toes; LFEP/RFEP are segment-axis points, not assumed exact hip centers

statistics: Per-trial framing, timing, valid-coordinate fractions and paired geometric shifts; no clinical group contrast
validation: CRC/SHA256; ezc3d vs c3d raw point comparison; manual pinhole vs OpenCV projectPoints for all finite point projections; rotation orthogonality and handedness; original frame-index interpolation; independent source/frame count and eligibility calculation
new_source_GDI_metadata: Discovered during raw C3D inspection, not model predictions. Preserve ANALYSIS and PROCESSING separately; no accuracy claim or selecting between conflicting values.
